starting_evidence.finding: The social feedback poll used the shared general waitFor, which converts every read error into a transient sample. Its timeout was then treated as a missed icon, allowing clipboard and T02 actions after a lost target or resource failure.

repair.boundary: Only the social feedback read now uses pollSocialFeedback. It accepts ordinary intact-pane false Check/X samples until the bounded icon window ends, then returns iconObserved false and permits actual clipboard verification.
repair.fatal_errors: Any read rejection propagates immediately. No lost-target, resource, or unexpected read error can become a missed-icon result; clipboard and independent T02 work are not reached after such a rejection.
repair.other_callers: The shared settings-panel-driver waitFor and other acceptance callers are unchanged.
